title: Half adder
description: Adds two bits: S is the sum bit and C is the carry.
source:
S = A XOR B
C = A AND B

title: De Morgan: NOT (A AND B)
description: NOT (A AND B) is the same as (NOT A) OR (NOT B).
source:
L = NOT (A AND B)
R = (NOT A) OR (NOT B)

title: De Morgan: NOT (A OR B)
description: NOT (A OR B) is the same as (NOT A) AND (NOT B).
source:
L = NOT (A OR B)
R = (NOT A) AND (NOT B)

title: 3-input alarm
description: The alarm sounds when it is armed (A) and either the door (B) or the window (C) is open.

title: Majority vote
description: The output is 1 when at least two of the three inputs are 1.
source: M = (A AND B) OR (A AND C) OR (B AND C)

title: XOR from NAND gates
description: Four NAND gates behave exactly like XOR.
source:
GATES = (A NAND (A NAND B)) NAND (B NAND (A NAND B))
DIRECT = A XOR B

title: Full adder
description: Adds A, B and a carry-in C: SUM is the sum bit and COUT the carry-out.
source:
SUM = (A XOR B) XOR C
COUT = (A AND B) OR (C AND (A XOR B))
